short_description: Cinematic death screen with ragdoll corpses, death cause tracking, grave epitaphs, lifetime stats dossier, and a live multiplayer scoreboard HUD.
long_description:
# DeathStats

A cinematic death screen, ragdoll physics, and player statistics mod for Luanti.

When you die in Luanti, DeathStats turns what used to be an instant respawn prompt into a cinematic moment. An orbiting camera circles your fallen character as ragdoll physics take over, custom banners and screen splatters react to how you met your end, and an on-screen dossier tallies everything you did during that life.

---

### Key Features

* **Cinematic Death Presentation**:
  * Themed "YOU DIED" banners and fullscreen screen splatters adapt to the cause of death (lava, fire, drowning, combat, and hazards).
  * Smooth 360° camera orbit around the fallen corpse with raycast obstacle avoidance to prevent wall clipping.
  * Photo Mode: hide all UI with an on-screen button or `/stats photo` for clean screenshots.
  * Natural CC0 vocal death groans and hurt sounds on impact.

* **Procedural Ragdoll Physics**:
  * Knockback and tumbling scaled to the fatal hit (explosions launch bodies, falls pancake on impact, and poison/starvation slump in place).
  * Terrain awareness: corpses roll down steep hills, match stair inclines, and settle into organic resting poses (prone, supine, lateral side-recovery, or sitting propped against a wall).
  * Appearance sync: accurately inherits your skin, equipped armor, wielded item, and custom meshes across popular skin frameworks (`skinsdb`, `3d_armor`, `clothing`, `player_api`, `mcl_skins`, etc.).
  * Bones mod compatible: docks cleanly onto placed bones blocks when `bones_mode = "bones"` is active so inventory drops stay fully functional.

* **Persistent Corpses & Grave Epitaphs**:
  * Corpses remain resting in the world for a few minutes (default: 3 minutes) before dissolving into a puff of smoke.
  * Other players can right-click any corpse to view an epitaph plaque with survival time, death cause, killer name, and humorous epitaph notes.
  * Strictly capped to 1 corpse per player to keep servers tidy.

* **Death Attribution & Nemesis Revenge**:
  * Tracks killers, weapons, and ranged projectile attacks (`x_bows` arrows, spells).
  * Environmental detection for falls, drowning, fire, lava, suffocation, void, and hunger/thirst frameworks (`hbhunger`, `stamina`, `thirsty`, `unified_stamina`).
  * Slaying your nemesis in your next life triggers a server-wide revenge announcement and awards the `[RVNG]` Avenger title badge.

* **Lifetime Dossier (`/stats`)**:
  * Summary of active life achievements: survival time, mined ores, combat damage dealt/taken, kills, crafted items, and distance traveled.
  * Interactive dashboard with tabs for Overview, Ores Breakdown, Combat & Mobs, and Server Hall of Fame.

* **Tactical Multiplayer Scoreboard**:
  * Hold **Sneak + Aux1** (or **Zoom**) to display a live HUD overlay showing player names, kills, deaths, K/D, damage, mined blocks, survival time, armor, health, ping, and AFK status.
  * Full scrollable roster dialog accessible anytime via `/scores`.
  * Pluggable column API: other mods can register custom metrics with `deathstats.register_scoreboard_column`.

---

### Scoreboard Extension API

Other mods can register custom columns with `deathstats.register_scoreboard_column`:

```lua
deathstats.register_scoreboard_column("coins", {
    order = 65,
    title = "COINS",
    title_small = "C",
    pct = 0.08,
    min_w = 45,
    icon = "deathstats_icon_star.png",
    tooltip = "Gold Coins",
    get_value = function(player, item, is_small)
        return tostring(my_economy.get_coins(item.name) or 0)
    end,
    get_color = function(player, item)
        return 0xFFD700
    end,
})
```

---

### Multiplayer Performance
* Throttled flailing updates (10 Hz in flight, 5 Hz on ground slides).
* Dirty-delta bone rotation filtering skips packets for micro-movements under 2.8°.
* Zero-cost settled state: resting corpses sleep with zero tick calculations.
* Non-loading node queries keep chunk loading light.
